title: NonMaxSuppressionWithOverlaps rejects documented scalar arguments
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found for scalar max_output_size or scalar threshold rejection in NonMaxSuppressionWithOverlaps.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 NonMaxSuppressionWithOverlaps docs list max_output_size as Union[Tensor, Number.int], overlap_threshold as Union[Tensor, Number.Float], score_threshold as Union[Tensor, Number.Float], and CPU support.
The all-Tensor scalar control passes in both PyNative and Graph mode.
Using a Python int max_output_size fails with a type error; using Python float thresholds fails with an internal GetShapeVector RuntimeError.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: all failures occur before returning the selected indices.
Not a CPU unsupported issue: the all-Tensor scalar control passes on CPU and CPU support is documented.
The issue affects both PyNative and Graph mode.
